main_text.p: dies meos, Psal.102.24. Hiph. Præt. הִקְצַרְתָּ יְמֵי עֲלוֹמִיו Decurtasti dies adolescentiæ ejus, Psalm.89.46.

קָצַר m. Brevis, Curtus, Contractus: Præceps. Constr. קְצַר אַפַּיִם Brevis irarum, Proverb.14.17. id est, Iracundus, Præceps ad iram: קְצַר־רוּחַ Brevis spiritu, verf.29. id est, Præceps animo: קְצַר יָמִים Brevis diebus, Job.14.1. Plur. Constr. קִצְרֵי יָד Breves manu, 2.Reg.19.26. id est, Contracti, Manci.
קֹצֶר m. Brevitas, Imminutio, Angustia: מִקְצַר רוּחַ Præ angustia spiritus, Exod.6.9.

קָצִיר m. Messis; Item Ramus, ab Amputando vel Decurtando: בִּימֵי קָצִיר In diebus messis, 2.Sam.21.9. Constr.: קְצִיר הַשְּׂעֹרִים Messis hordeorum, Ruth.2.v.23. Aff. יַמָּל[?] בְּקִצִּירִי Succidetur ramus ejus, Job.18.16. In ramo meo, Job.29.v.19. כִּי־תִקְצֹר קְצִירְךָ Quum metes messem tuam, Deut.24.19. Plur. cum Aff. הִשְׁלַח קְצִירֶיהָ Emisit ramos suos, Psalm.80.12.

קרא Vocavit, Advocavit, Accersivit, Convocavit, Evocavit, Invocavit, Invitavit, Clamavit, Exclamavit, Inclamavit, Proclamavit, proprie, Voce significata, conceptis & expressis verbis, quomodo ab aliis Clamandi verbis differt: Item Evenit, Obvenit, Occurrit, quæ significatio ad קְרָה pertinet. Item, Legit, ubi ad Scripturam, vel Librum refertur. Construitur cum ל sive Dativo, & Accusat. cum Præpositi ב, אֶל, עַל. Præterit. וְלַחֹשֶׁךְ קָרָא לַיְלָה Et tenebris, hoc est, tenebras vocavit noctem, Genes.1.5. וַיִּקְרָא לְךָ Et advocet te, invitet te, Exod.34.15. וַיִּקְרָא בוֹ Et leget in eo, Deut.17.19. וַיִּקְרָאֵהוּ Et obvenerit ipsi, Genes.42.38. בִּשְׁמְךָ לֹא קָרְאוּ In nomine tuo non vocant, Jerem.10.25. id est, Nomen tuum non invocant. Particip. Præs. לִמְעַן יָרוּץ קוֹרֵא בוֹ Ut percurrat legens in eo, Hab.2.2. Partic. Præter. קְרוּאֵי לְדֹ Voca-

Several Hebrew words at line ends and in the Hebrew examples are uncertain, especially the vowel points and the word after "Aff." in the קציר entry, and are marked [?] where they are doubtful.
